# Copilot instructions for this mini-project

- Treat the work item in `work-items/` as the source of truth.
- Inspect before editing. Keep changes minimal and scoped.
- Prefer a regression or acceptance test before production-code changes where practical.
- Never weaken or delete a valid test merely to get green.
- Run the targeted verifier, then the full suite.
- Stop before merge/deployment; a human reviews the diff and evidence.
- In your final summary include files changed, tests run, assumptions, and risks.
